provenance: Five excerpts cut from third-party World of Warships OST videos in D:/downloads with PyAV (libopus). No CAS-synthesized notes are used by this revision; the previous synthetic render is preserved under artifacts/client/audio-archive/old-score/ and its hashes are listed in previous_render.
rights: Third-party World of Warships OST. No public distribution clearance is recorded. Private CAS playtest use only; a public release requires clearance or a replacement with original/cleared music.
usage: Development server and local playtest builds. The score is not gated by VITE_CAS_LOCAL_VOICE in this increment; formal release must resolve the rights blocker first.
encoding: Stereo Ogg Opus (libopus), 48 kHz, 64 kbit/s VBR, application=audio
normalization: RMS -18.8 dBFS, peak ceiling -1.0 dBFS. Loop cues use a 2.0 s equal-power cyclic crossfade; one-shots use a 3.0 s fade-out.
loop_policy: For looping cues the decoded source is longer than the exported body by the crossfade length. The tail is mixed into the head, so the seam is continuous; see artifacts/client/audio-archive/score-build-report.json for exact source windows.

tracks.title: World of Warships OST 23
tracks.why: Cover art reads ACTION STATIONS; minor mode, 108 BPM, widest dynamic range (11.4 dB) of the short tracks; used for surface action.
